name: kamand-chat
description: Kamand Chat — Fast, private, fluid real-time messenger for IIT Mandi (First Commit Hackathon)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kamand/shared && npm run build --workspace=@kamand/server && npm run build --workspace=@kamand/client
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@kamand/shared && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@kamand/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@kamand/client"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build --workspace=@kamand/shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@kamand/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kamand/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@kamand/client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@kamand/shared && npm run test --workspace=@kamand/server && npm run test --workspace=@kamand/client
